spots.name: Homlokzatdísz
spots.blurb: You've reached Homlokzatdísz, a mural. Street art changes fast, so if the wall has been repainted, look around: the next piece is often close by.

spots.name: Bakteriofág
spots.blurb: You've reached Bakteriofág, a mural by Benes József from 1982. It shows matt tűzzománc kompozíció. Street art changes fast, so if the wall has been repainted, look around: the next piece is often close by.

spots.blurb: You've reached Karikó Katalin - Szentgyörgyi Albert, a mural by Fuchs Erik, Flór Péter from 2023. https://www.delmagyar.hu/helyi-kozelet/2023/12/kariko-katalin-es-szent-gyorgyi-albert-gigantikus-portreja-disziti-a-toronyhaz-tuzfalat.
